```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(freesurferformats)
library(corrplot)
```

# Correlation
```{r}
# Loading the Nifti files
vbm <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/correlation/means_VBM.txt')$V1
jd  <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/correlation/means_JD.txt')$V1
ct_lh <- read.fs.mgh('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/brain_data_u30/CT/lh_thickness_all.mgh')
ct_rh <- read.fs.mgh('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/brain_data_u30/CT/rh_thickness_all.mgh')
pa_lh <- read.fs.mgh('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/brain_data_u30/PA/lh_area_all.mgh')
pa_rh <- read.fs.mgh('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/brain_data_u30/PA/rh_area_all.mgh')


pa_lh_means <- colMeans(pa_lh) 
pa_rh_means <- colMeans(pa_rh) 
ct_lh_means <- colMeans(ct_lh) 
ct_rh_means <- colMeans(ct_rh) 

ct_means <- (ct_lh_means + ct_rh_means) / 2
pa_means <- (pa_lh_means + pa_rh_means) / 2

# Create dataframe with means
df_means <- data.frame(VBM = vbm, JD = jd, Area = pa_means, Thickness = ct_means)
dim(df_means)

# Correlation plot
meanscorr = cor(df_means)

corrplot(meanscorr, method = "color")

png(paste0('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/correlation_matrix.png'), 
    width=800, height=800, res=150)
corr_pos <- meanscorr
corr_pos[corr_pos < 0] <- 0
corrplot(corr_pos, method="color", addCoef.col="black", tl.col="black", number.cex=0.8, is.corr=FALSE)
dev.off()
```
